Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning utility donations to hunger programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to utility donations to hunger programs; adding anew section to chapter 54.16 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35.92RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.80 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 80.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 54.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Public utility districts may request voluntary donations fromtheir customers for the purpose of supporting hunger programs. (2) Voluntary donations collected by public utility districts underthis section may be used by the public utility district to support themaintenance and operation of hunger programs in the community. (3) Donations received under this section do not contribute to thegross income of a light and power business or gas distribution businessunder chapter 82.16 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.92 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Municipal utilities under this chapter may request voluntarydonations from their customers for the purpose of supporting hungerprograms. (2) Voluntary donations collected by municipal utilities under thissection may be used by the municipal utility to support the maintenanceand operation of hunger programs in the community. (3) Donations received under this section do not contribute to thegross income of a light and power business or gas distribution businessunder chapter 82.16 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Code cities providing utility services under this chapter mayrequest voluntary donations from their customers for the purpose ofsupporting hunger programs. (2) Voluntary donations collected by code cities under this sectionmay be used by the code city to support the maintenance and operationof hunger programs in the community. (3) Donations received under this section do not contribute to thegross income of a light and power business or gas distribution businessunder chapter 82.16 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Gas companies and electrical companies under this chapter mayrequest voluntary donations from their customers for the purpose ofsupporting hunger programs. (2) Voluntary donations collected by gas companies or electricalcompanies under this chapter may be used by the gas companies or theelectrical companies to support the maintenance and operation of hungerprograms in the community. (3) Donations received under this section do not contribute to thegross income of a light and power business or gas distribution businessunder chapter 82.16 RCW.
